intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Metairie for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 21 (North Pole Express Train Rides at Lakeside Shopping Center) through January 10, with Christmas in Lafreniere Park (December 1 to 30), Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer at the Jefferson Performing Arts Center (December 4 to 13) and Celebrate Christmas on the Crescent Lines at the Crescent City Model Railroad Club (November 28 and December 12 to 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website or an official tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Metairie

  • 10 Christmas events for kids in Metairie, River Ridge and Harahan
  • Free events: A Charlie Brown Christmas and Toy Giveaway at Victory Church (December 13)
  • Meet Santa: Letters From Santa Claus at the Harahan Library (November 30 to December 5)
  • Lights: Christmas in Lafreniere Park (December 1 to 30)
  • Trains: North Pole Express Train Rides at Lakeside Shopping Center ($2 per ride) and Celebrate Christmas on the Crescent Lines at the Crescent City Model Railroad Club
  • Shows: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer (December 4 to 13)
  • Library: Elf Party and Scavenger Hunt at River Ridge Library (December 10) and Harahan storytimes and crafts
  • Season: November 21 to January 10

Planning a bigger day out? Metairie families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in New Orleans, which covers Celebration in the Oaks, THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride and the West End Christmas Boat Parade.
